label: Database
summary: SSL database APIs, query return shapes, and parameterization rules.
must_follow: SQLExecute is the only database API that supports named ?param? substitution.
RunSQL, LSearch, LSelect, LSelect1, LSelectC, and GetDataSet use positional ? placeholders with value arrays.

Inside SQL strings, use uppercase SQL keywords and functions; preserve the author's casing for other SQL identifiers (force-folding is dialect-conditional and breaks case-sensitive SQL Server collations).
avoid: Do not use ?param? named substitution with non-SQLExecute database functions.
Do not concatenate user or runtime values into SQL when placeholders can bind them.
Do not pass empty trailing optional parameters when they can be omitted.

elements.name: SQLExecute
elements.summary: Executes SQL and returns either query results or a success flag.

elements.name: RunSQL
elements.summary: Executes a SQL statement and returns whether execution completed without an uncaught SQL error.

elements.name: LSearch
elements.summary: Returns a single value from a SQL query, or a caller-supplied fallback when the query produces no scalar result.

elements.name: LSelect
elements.summary: Executes a SQL SELECT statement and returns the result as a two-dimensional SSL array.

elements.name: LSelect1
elements.summary: Executes a parameterized SQL SELECT command and returns the result as an array of rows.

elements.name: LSelectC
elements.summary: Executes a SQL SELECT statement and returns the result as a two-dimensional SSL array.

elements.name: GetDataSet
elements.summary: Executes a SQL query on the default database connection and returns the result as an XML dataset string.

elements.name: GetConnectionStrings
elements.summary: Retrieves all configured database connections as a two-dimensional array.

elements.name: GetDefaultConnection
elements.summary: Returns the current default database connection name.

elements.name: SetDefaultConnection
elements.summary: Changes the active default database connection name and returns the previous default connection.

elements.name: LimsRecordsAffected
elements.summary: Returns the number of records affected by the most recent database operation.
